Eligibility Criteria for Overseas and Indian Faculty Aspirants at Nalanda University
1. The Position of Professor (Scale of Pay: USD 30,000-45,000 per Annum)
a) Outstanding academic record preferably with 60% marks or an equivalent grade in a
point scale wherever grading system is followed at the Masters’ level preferably with
international teaching experience.
b) Ph.D. or post-doctoral research in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline.
c) Brilliant teaching record spanning three (03) to seven (07) years as Associate Professor
or equivalent position with substantive experience of guiding doctoral and post-doctoral
research.
d) Actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with preferably ten (10)
publications as books and/or research/policy papers published in peer reviewed journals
of national and international repute.
e) Evidence of Innovative Courses/Teaching Plan/Research (desirable).
2. The Position of Associate Professor (Scale of Pay: USD 20,000-35,000 per Annum)
a) Brilliant academic record preferably with 60% marks or an equivalent grade in a point
scale wherever grading system is followed at the Masters level preferably with
international teaching experience.
b) Ph.D. or post-doctoral research in the allied/relevant discipline.
c) A minimum of Three (03) to Five (05) years of experience in teaching and research at
national and international level with substantive experience of guiding doctoral research.
d) Actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with preferably Eight (8)
publications as books and/or research/policy papers published in peer reviewed journals
of national and international repute.
e) Evidence of Innovative Courses/Teaching Plan/Research (desirable).
3. The Position of Assistant Professor (Scale of Pay: USD 15,000-25,000 per Annum
a) Good academic record with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent grade in a point
scale at the Master’s level in a relevant subject from an Indian or foreign University.
b) Ph.D. or post-doctoral research in the allied/relevant discipline.
c) Actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of Three
(3) to Five (5) publications as books and/or research/policy papers published in peer
reviewed journals of national and international repute.
d) Evidence of Innovative Courses/Teaching Plan/Research (desirable).
